parsed.text: Panels p0 and p1 contain paired red/blue location distributions over a 4x4 local grid. Current (non-conditional) estimates: for both panels at node n0, red mass peaks across the top-left 2x2 cells and blue mass peaks across the top-right 2x2 cells; nodes n1, n2 and n3 are uniform across all 16 cells. Candidate command records: k0 and k1 mostly repeat uniform or the same bimodal n0 pattern; k2 is distinct for node n0, concentrating blue on cell [0,2] and red on cell [0,0] (single-cell peaks). Origins: copied prior records are not new estimates, and native conditional command records are conditional (not executed events). The prose summarizes the supplied distributions; numerical peak lists are provided separately.
